data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided scientific journal figure while preserving the exact overall canvas aspect ratio, three-column layout, panel borders, title tabs, labels, color coding, and compact paper-figure composition. Keep the same white background and crisp SCI-style presentation, but correct the geometry and sensing logic per the following instructions.

Global: preserve the three major columns labeled Glare, Specular, Dark; preserve the top row plan-view map, middle row third-person scene renders, and bottom row drone-camera / sensor-observation panels. Keep the blue flight/path arrows and dashed observation boxes, but correct their direction and geometry. Do not add extra objects, logos, people, decorative backgrounds, extra drones, or unrelated text.

Top plan-view map: redraw to match a correct 2D layout with x as flight direction and y as lateral direction. Show Start at x = -1.0 on the left and Goal at x = 1.8 on the right. Show the front wall at x = 0.65 as two separated horizontal wall blocks with a central gap/slit between them (no closed frame across the slit, no top/bottom doorway frame). Show the slit as a vertical opening centered at z = 1.5 and located at one of the lateral slots. Show the back wall as one solid transverse wall behind the slit, wider in y than the front wall. Keep the four lateral sample markers far_left, left, right, far_right as faint dashed vertical lines behind the front wall and aligned to y positions; they should be visually secondary. Preserve the x/y axis indicator. Ensure the blue path arrow flows from Start toward the slit and on to Goal.

Middle row third-person scene panels: the drone must face inward toward the slit in all three panels; the camera lens should point toward the wall opening, not toward the viewer. The blue trajectory arrows must point from the drone toward the slit, into the scene. Keep the floor tiles, walls, slit, back wall, and drone visible. Glare: orange/white light at the slit and warm spill on the wall, but not fully washed out. Specular: glossy cyan-white reflections on the side-wall patches near the slit edges. Dark: dark low-reflectance patches on the side walls near the slit edges. Maintain readable semi-photorealistic 3D render style.

Bottom row drone-camera / sensor-observation panels: make these look like degraded active-depth outputs, distinct from the middle-row RGB renderings. The slit edges in all three sensor-observation panels should be degraded, not perfectly sharp. Glare observation: gray sensor-like view with white washed-out speckle/clouds and bright saturated regions around the slit edges; the slit boundary should be hard to localize. Specular observation: clearly show false-depth behavior with cyan/white vertical glints near both slit edges, noisy speckles, and curved cyan arrows indicating false near-depth or edge drift; the wall-slit boundary should look unstable, not clean. Include the near/far depth bar. Dark observation: weak return with black/dark noisy vertical bands near both slit edges, sparse speckles, and reduced edge contrast. Keep the compact labels 'washed-out cue', 'false depth', and 'weak return'.

Style: clean scientific figure, semi-photorealistic 3D render panels combined with crisp diagram annotations, thin black borders, subtle shadows, consistent fonts, white background. Preserve the original panel composition and label placement as much as possible while correcting the geometry and sensor effects.
